Company description: MCD (Generated via gemini-3.5-flash-lite)

MCD is the stock ticker for McDonald's Corporation, the world’s leading global foodservice retailer. Founded in 1940 as a restaurant operated by brothers Richard and Maurice McDonald in San Bernardino, California, the enterprise transformed significantly after businessman Ray Kroc joined the company as a franchise agent in 1955 and subsequently purchased the business. Headquartered in Chicago, Illinois, McDonald's primarily operates through a franchise-based business model, generating revenue from a combination of company-operated restaurant sales and franchise fees, royalties, and rent. The corporation manages a vast international footprint, serving tens of millions of customers daily across more than 100 countries. Recognized globally for its signature menu items, including the Big Mac and World Famous Fries, the company continually adapts its offerings to meet changing consumer preferences while maintaining a powerful real estate portfolio that underpins its financial stability.
